result.topic_en: Calculations with sums over divisors of the form p^α q^β r^γ, written as alternating sums of powers of z, together with a cross-ratio-type identity and geometric-series manipulations of divisor sums.
result.transcription:
[-Afilfun[?]-]
$\text{fur}.\,v = [z]$
$\text{fur}\,qv = [z^q - z]$
$\text{fur}\,q^2v = [z^{q^2} - z^q]$
$\text{fur}\,q^3v = [z^{q^3} - z^{q^2}]$
$\text{fur}.\,pqv = [z^{pq} - z^p - z^q + z]$
$\text{fur}\,pq^2v = [z^{pq^2} - z^{pq} - z^{q^2} + z^q]$

$\alpha\beta\cdot\gamma\delta = \alpha\delta\cdot\gamma\beta + \alpha\gamma\,\beta\delta$

$-z^{pq} + z^p + z^q - z$
$-z^p \quad + z$
$-z^q \quad + z$
$-z$
$-z^{q^2} \quad + z^q$

[-...-]
$\frac{1}{v}\Big[\frac{z^{pq^2} - z^{pq} - z^{q^2} + z^q}{pq^2} + \frac{z^{pq} - z^p - z^q + z}{pq} + \frac{z^{q^2} - z^q}{q^2} + \frac{z^p - z}{p} + \frac{z^q - z}{q} + z\Big]$

$\frac{(p'-1)p'^{\alpha+1}(q'-1)q'^{\beta-1}(r'-1)r'^{\gamma-1}}{p^\alpha q^\beta r^\gamma}$[?]

[-$\frac{r'}{r}\ldots\frac{r'}{r}$-]

$\left(\frac{r'}{r} - \frac{1}{r}\right)\left[\frac{r'}{r}^{\alpha-1} \cdots\cdots 1\right]\frac{q'^{(\beta-1)}}{q}$

$\left(\left(\frac{r'}{r} - \frac{1}{r}\right)\frac{\frac{r'}{r}^{\alpha} - 1}{\frac{r'}{r} - 1} + 1\right)$

$\left((r'-1)\frac{(r'^\alpha - r^\alpha)}{r'-r} + r^\alpha\right)r^{-\alpha}$ \quad $\left(\frac{r'^{\alpha+1} - r^{\alpha+1}}{r'-r} - \frac{r'^\alpha - r^\alpha}{r'-r}\right)$

$r'^{\alpha+1} - r^\alpha r' - r'^\alpha + r^\alpha - r^{\alpha+1}$
$+$

Ptolemy/three-term identity for products of pairs
Sum over divisors of pq^2 of the z-expressions divided by the divisor
